name: Balnarring Market
address: Balnarring Village Green, Frankston-Flinders Rd, Balnarring VIC 3926
signature: A relaxed village-scale monthly market on the Balnarring Village Green, local produce, makers, and the Peninsula's most family-friendly market morning.
editorNote:
Balnarring Market is a village-scale monthly event, a village-scale monthly event on the Balnarring Village Green that runs on the third Saturday of each month through the warmer months. The stalls lean more toward local produce and smaller craft makers, and the whole event moves at a relaxed pace. No queues for parking, no sprint to the good stalls, the Balnarring version assumes you are not in a hurry.

This is the market to take visiting family to when you want the produce-and-craft experience without a crowded itinerary. It is also the right warm-up for anyone who has booked a lunch at The Heritage, the village pub, or a cellar-door session at Quealy afterwards, a loose, unhurried market morning leads naturally into a loose, unhurried afternoon.

Go late morning, buy what looks good, and drift into a long Balnarring afternoon.
